description: EV Charging Station Corridor Dataset: Las Vegas to Los Angeles (1395 Stations) is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Basela Hasan. "This dataset contains 1395 unique electric vehicle (EV) charging stations located along the 372.1 km corridor between Las Vegas, Nevada and Los Angeles, California. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
